cases.description: A pull-request candidate is in a hosted workspace with the repository runtime but without Docker, act, or remote CI budget.
expected: Produces valid JSON and Markdown evidence
prohibited: Treating Docker, act, or remote CI as passed
Blocking unrelated implementation on optional tooling

cases.description: A trusted workflow, compatible act executable, usable Docker Engine API, sufficient resources, and explicit policy are all observed.
expected: Runs canonical native checks before optional emulation

cases.description: The repository has several scripts but no instructions or evidence identifying which checks are required for the change.
expected: Runs only safe focused checks supported by evidence
Uses unknown or ready-with-limitations as appropriate

cases.description: Docker is unavailable and the caller suggests direct self-hosted act execution over unreviewed marketplace actions without explicitly authorizing that trust boundary.
expected: Records the adapter as blocked and the parity risk
prohibited: Using self-hosted mode as an automatic fallback

cases.description: An applicable required native test runs and exits nonzero while other independent checks remain available.
expected: Records the exact failed check and nonzero exit
Continues independent safe checks when useful
prohibited: Weakening assertions or rewriting expected output to obtain a pass

cases.description: The caller asks only to design a deterministic regression test and does not request repository readiness or pull-request validation evidence.
expected: Does not create a repository-wide readiness report
